trust_decision.summary: Admin-authored rich-text setting disable_booking_message is trusted as safe HTML: stored unfiltered by the settings save and echoed raw into the public booking-disabled page (other rich-text settings already go through pure_html/HTMLPurifier).

landing_point.why: Summary says the message is 'rendered as raw HTML on public booking page'; this is the raw echo of message_text, fed from Booking::index at application/controllers/Booking.php:145.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: application/controllers/Booking_settings.php:104-122 (fix.diff:36-41 purifies on save, a different file and layer from the view the summary points to)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the view purifies on output the public page is safe, so sanitizing again on save (or on the API/other settings controllers that also write this row) looks redundant; the API caller already has an admin-equivalent token.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: disable_booking_message is a Trumbowyg rich-text field; bold/links/lists must still render on the public page, so escaping with e()/htmlspecialchars breaks it. The same view also shows built-in lang() messages and Booking_cancellation's pre-escaped e($e->getMessage()), so double escaping is a risk.

O6_input_shapes: HTML string value of disable_booking_message in booking_settings[] array (save side)
stored HTML string read back via setting() and rendered (render side)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Settings API v1 PUT api/v1/settings/disable_booking_message writes the value raw through setting(), skipping save-side purification
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: API is a separate integration surface with admin-equivalent auth; public page is already purified on output

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legal_settings save has no setting-name allow-list, so a disable_booking_message entry is stored raw
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legal page is a neighbouring feature that only manages legal content; the name-keyed purify there covers only its own three fields

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Business_settings save has no setting-name allow-list, so the same row can be written raw
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Business settings page never shows this field

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Stored raw value is loaded back into the backend Trumbowyg editor as HTML (admin-side render of the same stored value)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-only screen, editor is the intended HTML consumer; advisory names the public page only
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: client-side JS, different language and tree (assets/js)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A configurable cancellation-confirmation rich-text setting rendered through the same booking_message view
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The controller already reuses booking_message with message_text; adding an admin-editable message there mirrors disable_booking_message.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An admin-editable 'appointment not found' message setting passed as message_text
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same html_vars pattern; a maintainer swapping lang() for setting() would not re-sanitize.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS (admin-controlled rich text rendered unfiltered on a public page)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >=8.2, Composer (ezyang/htmlpurifier ^4.19, phpunit ^12.4.2), CodeIgniter 3-style app; npm for assets
O10_build.project_tests: Only tests/Unit/Helper/ArrayHelperTest.php and tests/Unit/Helper/ValidationHelperTest.php; no controller, view or settings tests. vendor/ is not checked in.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap message_text in pure_html() (or e()) in booking_message.php only, leaving the stored value raw on every write path.

out_of_scope_notes: General_settings stores cookie/terms/privacy content without pure_html (application/controllers/General_settings.php:130-148); output is purified in the modals, so not pursued.
Booking_settings, Business_settings and Legal_settings save accept arbitrary setting names (no allow-list), unlike General_settings:137; that is broad mass-assignment, separate from this advisory.
unverified: repo_mb: no shell available to measure size; tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed.

Whether hidden tests can observe save-side purification (needs DB-backed controller test with MySQL); render-side purify alone closes the public sink, so the O8 write routes matter only if tests check the stored value or the admin editor.
Whether Trumbowyg's 'html' setter runs event-handler attributes in this bundled version was not checked.
